quiz.q: What is the range of f(x)=−2x2+12x−7?f(x)=−2x2+12x−7 的值域是什么？
opts: y≥11
y≤3
y≤11
y≤−61
quiz.hint: Axis first, then the vertex y-value, then the direction from the sign of a.先求对称轴，再算顶点纵坐标，最后看 a 的符号定方向。
quiz.why: Correct: axis x=−2(−2)12​=3, f(3)=11, opens down, so y≤11.正确：对称轴 x=−2(−2)12​=3，f(3)=11，开口向下，y≤11。
whys: Wrong direction: a=−2<0 opens down, so the vertex is a maximum and the range is y≤.方向反了：a=−2<0 开口向下，顶点是最大值，值域应是 y≤。
Used the vertex x-value 3; the range is about y, so use f(3)=11.用了顶点横坐标 3；值域说的是 y，要用 f(3)=11。
Correct: axis x=−2(−2)12​=3, f(3)=11, opens down, so y≤11.正确：对称轴 x=−2(−2)12​=3，f(3)=11，开口向下，y≤11。
Sign slip in the axis (x=−3), so f(−3)=−61 is not the vertex.对称轴算错了符号（x=−3），f(−3)=−61 不是顶点。

quiz.q: A parabola opens down, has x-intercepts −1 and 7, and passes through (1,6). What is its maximum value?一条开口向下的抛物线，x 截距为 −1 和 7，且过点 (1,6)。它的最大值是多少？
opts: 6
16
3
8
quiz.hint: The axis is the midpoint of the zeros; the extra point only fixes a.对称轴是零点中点；多出来的点只用来求 a。
quiz.why: Correct: y=a(x+1)(x−7), 6=a(2)(−6) gives a=−21​; at x=3: −21​(4)(−4)=8.正确：y=a(x+1)(x−7)，6=a(2)(−6) 得 a=−21​；x=3 时 −21​(4)(−4)=8。
whys: Took the given point as the top; (1,6) is not on the axis x=3.把给的点当成了最高点；(1,6) 不在对称轴 x=3 上。
Skipped finding a (used a=−1); zeros alone do not fix the height.没求 a（直接当 a=−1）；只有零点定不出高度。
Gave the x-coordinate of the vertex; the maximum value is a y-value.给的是顶点横坐标；最大值是纵坐标。
Correct: y=a(x+1)(x−7), 6=a(2)(−6) gives a=−21​; at x=3: −21​(4)(−4)=8.正确：y=a(x+1)(x−7)，6=a(2)(−6) 得 a=−21​；x=3 时 −21​(4)(−4)=8。

quiz.q: If f(x)=3x2−x+2, then f(−2) equals:若 f(x)=3x2−x+2，则 f(−2) 等于：
opts: 12
16
8
−8
quiz.hint: Use brackets: 3(−2)2−(−2)+2.加括号：3(−2)2−(−2)+2。
quiz.ans: 16
quiz.why: 3(4)+2+2=16.3(4)+2+2=16。

quiz.q: A decorative fountain in a Vancouver plaza shoots a jet of water from a nozzle at ground level, and the jet lands 6 m away. At 1 m from the nozzle the water is 2.5 m high. Let x be the horizontal distance from the nozzle. (a) Find the equation of the path and the maximum height. (b) Between which two horizontal distances is the water at least 4 m high? Use symmetry to explain why the answers are where they are.温哥华广场上的装饰喷泉从地面的喷嘴射出一股水柱，落点距喷嘴 6 m。距喷嘴 1 m 处水柱高 2.5 m。设 x 为到喷嘴的水平距离。(a) 求水柱路径的方程和最大高度。(b) 水柱在哪两个水平距离之间高度至少 4 m？用对称性解释为什么答案落在那两处。
quiz.hint: Ground level at x=0 and x=6 gives the factored form y=ax(x−6); use the point (1,2.5) for a.地面高度出现在 x=0 和 x=6，所以设 y=ax(x−6)，再用点 (1,2.5) 求 a。
quiz.ans: y=−21​x(x−6); maximum 4.5 m at x=3; at least 4 m high for 2≤x≤4y=−21​x(x−6)；最大高度 4.5 m（在 x=3 处）；2≤x≤4 时高度至少 4 m
quiz.why: The jet is at height 0 when x=0 and x=6, so y=ax(x−6). From (1,2.5): 2.5=a(1)(−5), so a=−21​ and y=−21​x(x−6).水柱高度为 0 的位置是 x=0 和 x=6，所以 y=ax(x−6)。代入 (1,2.5)：2.5=a(1)(−5)，得 a=−21​，y=−21​x(x−6)。
